name: Eniwa (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Eniwa city emblem in white and yellow: four interlocking rings around a yellow character 恵.
history: Municipal flag of Eniwa, a city in Hokkaido; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 September 1961.

features.role: Eniwa city emblem — four interlocking rings around a yellow character 恵
